# Acme Analytics

Product analytics that answer questions, not dashboards

Acme Analytics turns raw product events into plain-language answers. Ask a question, get a chart and an explanation, and share it with your team in one click.

## Features

### Ask in plain English

Type a question about your product and get a chart back in seconds.

### Auto insights

Acme watches your funnels and tells you what changed and why.

### Share anywhere

Send a live chart to Slack or paste it into a doc.

## Who it is for

Product teams at growing saas companies.

## Pricing

Starts free. Team plans from $29 per month.
